# ArcCards - Web3 Trading Card Game Platform

> AI-friendly documentation for ArcCards, a decentralized trading card game marketplace built on Base blockchain.

## About ArcCards

ArcCards is a Web3 decentralized application (dApp) that enables users to collect, trade, and battle with digital trading cards from popular franchises including Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and Dragon Ball. Built on Base L2 for low-cost, high-speed transactions.

## Key Features

- **Gacha System**: Open card packs to collect rare and legendary cards
- **NFT Marketplace**: Buy, sell, and trade cards with other players
- **Wallet Integration**: Connect via MetaMask, WalletConnect, and other Web3 wallets
- **Base L2 Blockchain**: Fast transactions with minimal gas fees
- **Real-time Trading**: Live marketplace with instant price updates

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- **Blockchain**: Ethereum (Base L2), Solidity Smart Contracts
- **Wallet**: Wagmi v2, Viem, Reown AppKit
- **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL), Redis caching
- **Deployment**: Vercel Edge Network

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://cardarc.vercel.app/) - Landing page and gacha system
- [Marketplace](https://cardarc.vercel.app/marketplace) - Trade cards with other players
- [Profile](https://cardarc.vercel.app/profile) - View your collection and stats
- [Leaderboard](https://cardarc.vercel.app/leaderboard) - Top collectors and traders

## Smart Contracts

- **ArcCards**: ERC-721 NFT contract for card minting and ownership
- **ArcMarketplace**: Decentralized marketplace for card trading
- **Network**: Base Sepolia (testnet), Base Mainnet (production)

## API Endpoints

- `/api/gacha/claim` - Claim gacha rewards
- `/api/webhooks/validate` - Validate blockchain transactions
